workflow.name: S14c_0A2 Sua bep buoi sang
workflow.description: Sửa ảnh bếp buổi sáng GỐC chọn ở 0A (ảnh chưa sửa): tải vào IMG_BEP_SANG_CU, chạy BG_B_MORNING_FIX, chọn 1 ảnh làm BG_B_MORNING (dùng ở 0B và các file F có cảnh bếp). Bản 23/10: sửa 4 chỗ như cũ và làm bếp sáng, trắng ra trắng.

nodes.prompt: Edit Image 1, a photo of an empty kitchen in the morning. Keep the same kitchen exactly: the same white cabinets, counter, double sink under the window, white gas range, range hood, cast-iron skillet, white crock of teal silicone utensils, paper towel holder, soap bottles, wall phone, fridge, floor, camera position and framing. Change only these five things: 1) The paper hand fan hanging beside the wall phone: its printed side now shows a simple painting of a small white country church under a blue sky, with no people and no words, letters or writing anywhere on the fan. 2) The snapshots on the fridge door: replace every photo with snapshots of one Black American family, only adults: an older Black woman with short silver hair smiling with two church friends, a Black man in his forties with a salt-and-pepper beard beside his wife, and a young Black woman with long braids in a graduation cap; every person in every photo is Black American; keep the same number of photos, the same sizes, magnets and places, small and a little soft; the paper notes on the fridge are blank. 3) Remove the cereal boxes and everything else from the top of the fridge. 4) Add a white step trash can with a foot pedal and a lid on the floor at the end of the counter, lit like everything around it, with a soft contact shadow on the floor. 5) The light: a bright, fresh early morning. Clear sunlight comes in through the window over the sink and falls across the counter, and soft daylight bounces around the whole room, so the upper and lower cabinets, the fridge and the floor are clearly lit, with gentle open shadows and nothing dark or gloomy in the corners. The white cabinets, the range and the fridge look clean, true white, not grey or green; the walls a soft warm cream; only the shadows keep a slight cool morning freshness. The window is bright but keeps its frame and a soft view outside. The old kitchen looks well kept and cared for. Looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors; no over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. No people. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos. Final check: the same kitchen as Image 1; only the fan picture, the fridge photos, the top of the fridge, the new trash can and the brighter light changed.
